system.description:
Battle Amp, Max Rank: 5

Your clans inherent lust for combat rises to the surface increasing your combat potential. You can spend Battle lust to enhance Kaguya Clan Hijutsu;

Accelerated Assault. You gain a +5 bonus to speed, for each rank you have.

Battle Focus. You gain an additional reaction, which you can only take to perform opportunity attacks, for each rank you have, per round.

Violent Desire. Damage you deal to creature with ranks of Bleed is increased by +2.

Calming Down. If you did not deal or take damage before the end of your turn, you lose a rank of Battle Lust.
system.summary: Ranks up to 5: +5 speed and an extra opportunity-attack reaction per rank. +2 damage to bleeding creatures.

rules.text: Ranks come from Shikotsumyaku Stance, Desire for Battle and Dance of the Pale Tyrant; Kaguya Hijutsu spend them.
Per rank: +5 speed and one extra reaction for opportunity attacks (at the table).
Calming Down: lose a rank if you neither dealt nor took damage by the end of your turn.
